owner_requirements: gb_feedback_0045/0130/0145: after a miss, preregister the next version immediately with ONE lever; publish only on a full preregistered pass
standing: smoke gate before the full run, with the lever provably exercised; PRs off main; nice 19; launch gated on main CI green and load < 70 in one command (no SIGSTOP pausing)
question: If the frozen v0.0.22 start faces half of the ES pairs instead of a third, does the 16-iteration checkpoint stop losing to it (monotonicity) while keeping the primary and the v0.0.13 hard gate?
lever: ONE change from v0.0.28: the training rotation becomes [frozen v0.0.19, frozen v0.0.22 base, frozen v0.0.13, frozen v0.0.22 base] (ES pair k faces slot k % 4; both twins of a pair face the same spec), so 6 of 12 pairs face the base (v0.0.28: 4) and 3 face each frozen external opponent (v0.0.28: 4). Fitness, v0.0.22 start, lr 0.05, sigma 0.1, 48x12, 0.5 m reset and ending v2 as v0.0.28. Per-slot rank-share logging (motor_gate.train log_rank_shares) is instrumentation only: it never changes the update (tested).
why_this_lever: cycle 0044 (post hoc, non-gating): the training trial agrees with head-to-head vs the base (refuting v0.0.28's registered 'match-outcome term' reading); over its first 16 iterations v0.0.28 raised its trial fitness vs v0.0.19 (1.50 -> 1.59) and v0.0.13 (1.50 -> 1.73) while dropping it vs the base (0.99 -> 0.69; @16 lost 2-46), then recovered (@48 beat @16 46-2 and the base 43-5 post hoc). Measured: the base received 0.23-0.28 of the update's |rank difference| for a third of the pairs. Per-opponent ranks would only lift it to ~0.31, so this lever raises the base's share of pairs instead; expected update share ~0.4.
classification: solo motor fitness against a frozen opponent (no match outcome in the fitness); diagnostic, not an unassisted boxing result
env: grokbot.scenarios.RangeBoxingEnv(separation_m=0.5, horizon_ticks=3000); unchanged jekko env; runs to the horizon (does not stop at the first fall)

training.method: grokbot.motor_gate.train antithetic ES with CRN, run as 16 + 32 iterations on one generator (identical to one 48-iteration call) so the @16 checkpoint is kept
training.opponent: cycling per ES pair over 4 slots: frozen v0.0.19 (group_pd, noise 0.05), frozen v0.0.22 base (group_pd, noise 0.05), frozen v0.0.13 champion (punch, noise 0.05), frozen v0.0.22 base
training.load_rule: launch in one command only after main CI on the merged prereg commit is success AND loadavg < 70; nice 19; never SIGSTOP-paused

gate.stance_pass: candidate stands (no persistent non-foot floor support) for the full 3000 ticks
gate.reach_pass: candidate lands >= 1 strike tick (approach and referee active speed >= 0.5 m/s on a strike target)
gate.also_reported: scoring_reach_rate (share of trials with >= 1 head/torso hit); not part of the primary gate
gate.note: motor gate vs gen4, reported (not gating)

primary.name: vs frozen v0.0.19 on NEW seeds 44000-44023 (48 games), checked in order

head_to_head.env: grokbot.reference_env.ReferenceEndingEnv(RangeBoxingEnv(separation_m=0.5, horizon_ticks=3000), anti_stalling=True) via grokbot.selfplay.play_game (ending v2, unchanged)
head_to_head.candidate: the trained v0.0.29 GroupPDPolicy, eval noise 0.05
head_to_head.opponent: frozen v0.0.19: kind group_pd, v0.0.19 final_params, eval noise 0.05
head_to_head.sides: each seed with the candidate in corner A and in corner B (48 games)
head_to_head.valid: grokbot.selfplay.valid_result; every game stays in the denominator
head_to_head.elo: Elo = 400*log10(p/(1-p)) with p = (1+mean)/2 clipped to [0.5/n, 1-0.5/n]; Elo lower bound from p_low = (1+lower95)/2 (-inf if p_low <= 0); win rate with a Wilson 95% interval (descriptive)

order: 1. VALIDITY: valid games (selfplay.valid_result) >= 40/48, else verdict VALIDITY_FAILED (fail loud: non-zero exit, later criteria not evaluated)
2. DECISIVENESS: decisive games (valid wins + valid losses, i.e. not draws) >= 24/48, else verdict DECISIVE_FAILED (fail loud)
3. (b) Hoeffding lower95 > 0 and (c) >= half of the candidate's valid wins with >= 1 candidate head/torso hit; else CRITERION_NOT_MET; both pass -> PRIMARY_PASSED

hard_gate_v0013.opponent: frozen v0.0.13 (punch, punch_params(gen4, onset=-3, duration=0, amplitude=2)), eval noise 0.05

monotonicity.pass: for each: valid >= 40/48 first, then Wilson 95% lower bound of the more-trained side's win rate over valid games > 0.55 (same rule as the v0.0.21 addendum)

level_up: tag v0.0.29 iff the smoke gate passed AND primary verdict PRIMARY_PASSED AND hard_gate_v0013 passes AND both monotonicity matchups pass

secondary_reported_not_gating.baseline: v0.0.19 self-mirror on the primary seeds
secondary_reported_not_gating.vs_v0016: candidate vs frozen v0.0.16 on seeds 45000-45023
secondary_reported_not_gating.motor_gate: candidate and v0.0.19 (re-run, checked per trial against its committed summary) vs gen4
secondary_reported_not_gating.training: per-iteration stand time, knockdown_share, valid_knockdown_share, mean_contact_ticks, rank_share_by_slot (the base's measured share of every update)
secondary_reported_not_gating.reporting: every head-to-head split by the stronger side's seat with wins / losses / draws / no-contests / blocked / engine faults counted separately
secondary_reported_not_gating.blocked_diagnosis: for every blocked game in the primary, hard gate and monotonicity: count; the per-seat split shows them separately
secondary_reported_not_gating.contact_rate: per-iteration mean_contact_ticks (both opponents mixed), per-game contact ticks in the primary and hard gate (owner 21:50/22:05: confirm the penalty is not gamed by avoiding contact)

smoke_gate.when: first stage of the probe, before any training
smoke_gate.policy: the v0.0.22 base policy (group_pd, eval noise 0.05)
smoke_gate.opponent: penalty check: the two frozen external training opponents, alternating per seed; lever check: the 4-slot training rotation; validity check: frozen v0.0.19 (the primary opponent)

bonus_check.what: motor_gate.trial of the v0.0.22 base, seeds alternating vs frozen v0.0.19 (even index) and frozen v0.0.13 (odd index) - the two external training opponents (the third, the base itself, is checked by the validity-style mirror below)
bonus_check.why: the lever must carry signal against EACH training opponent (24 trials each); valid-knockdown share reported

validity_check.what: selfplay.play_game head-to-head of the v0.0.22 base vs frozen v0.0.19 under ReferenceEndingEnv (0.5 m, anti-stalling, ending v2)

smoke_gate.on_fail: SMOKE_FAILED if any check (penalty, lever, validity) fails: non-zero exit, no training, no gates

lever_check.what: motor_gate.train from the v0.0.22 base on the 4-slot rotation with lr 0.0 and log_rank_shares, on its own generator (training's generator is untouched); base share = rank_share_by_slot[1] + rank_share_by_slot[3] per batch
lever_check.why: the lever must provably raise the base's measured share of the update above v0.0.28's measured 0.23-0.28 (cycle 0044); params must be unchanged by an lr-0 call
